claim.quote: The technique is demonstrated by tagging the direction of the nuclear recoils created in the scattering of low-energy neutrons with CF4 in a low-pressure time-projection chamber that is developed by the DMTPC collaboration.

name: Observation of the 'head-tail' effect in nuclear recoils of low-energy neutrons

summary.plain: DMTPC showed in the lab that a low-pressure gas chamber can tell which way a recoiling nucleus was going (the head-tail effect), using low-energy neutrons.
summary.technical: Observation of the head-tail effect in CF4 nuclear recoils from low-energy neutron scattering with scintillation (CCD) readout; the decreasing ionization rate along the trajectory gives the direction tag.

title: Observation of the 'head-tail' effect in nuclear recoils of low-energy neutrons
why_it_matters: The abstract says this proves the head-tail effect can be observed, the basis for the vector direction of dark matter recoils.
